description: This file is a shell script used for managing Wi-Fi interfaces, hostapd process, network configurations, and related system commands on a router device. It contains functions for restarting hostapd, modifying configuration files, bridging interfaces, and starting network services.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd
methods.description: Restarts the hostapd service on wlan0 by stopping and starting it with the configuration file.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd_5G
methods.description: Restarts the hostapd service for the 5G interface by reloading kernel modules and starting hostapd with the respective configuration.

methods.name: Hostapd_Restart
methods.description: Kills existing hostapd processes and restarts the hostapd service on wlan0.
